idea.title: Idea
idea.description: Capture and refine GateFlow initiatives into IDEA_<slug>.md and backlog entries.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Turn an IDEA_<slug>.md into a phased PLAN_<slug>.md plus PROMPT_<slug>_phase_<N>.md pro prompts.

dev.title: Dev
dev.description: Implement exactly one plan phase end-to-end (code, tests, git).

ship.title: Ship
ship.description: Execute all remaining phases of a plan sequentially via repeated /dev-style execution.

guide.title: Guide
guide.description: Run the GateFlow workspace guide — what should I do now?

man.title: Man
man.description: One Man — one command, seven domains (Code, Brand, SaaS, Marketing, Business, Content, Copywrite).

clis-team.title: CLIs Team
clis-team.description: Run a predefined CLI team (seo, refactor, audit). Cursor is master; team outputs are proposals.

docs.title: Docs
docs.description: Automated documentation updates — changelog, version badge, PRD, feature log, README, release.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semantic versioning — bump package.json, create annotated git tags, generate versioned branch names.

organize.title: Organize
organize.description: Docs folder cleanup — scan structure, remove empty dirs and dead symlinks, rebuild docs/INDEX.md.

ralph.title: Ralph
ralph.description: Recursive autopilot: implement ALL remaining phases of the active plan end-to-end until complete. Includes session memory, TDD, enforcement, verification, PR.
